requirements.requirement: All three General choices save through the existing field-patch path and retain keyboard focus while busy.
All three native Mode submenu items persist the preference; reselecting the current item restores exactly one checked item after the native checkbox toggle.

Tray only destroys an expanded island WebView and its native host. Island-specific views/sessions are absent and its sampler blocks; it does not count the separate settings/main observers as island windows.
Island only requests the hidden tray; injected Alt+Space opens the actual island without a tray WebView, its gear opens settings, and foreground focus remains outside the owned test app.

Queued events publish before workers can overtake them. Real fake downloads exercise queue, running progress, pause, cancel, resume and idle; a blocked Rust worker handles notifications and native tray updates are coalesced.
The original optical glyph alpha is preserved, with a monochrome progress mark or paused indicator below it. Exact native RGBA is checked at owned 16/24px seams in both taskbar themes.

Only a new active completion in tray-only routes to the Windows toast adapter. Duplicate/history events are silent; island modes keep their existing activity flow. Real Windows XML/ToastNotification construction is tested with Show suppressed.

The fixed nabbit://downloads activation opens Downloads without changing the job list or staged capture. Payload-bearing/lookalike URIs are rejected by the narrow parser. The OS-registered protocol hop is outside automation.
Both island-only and tray-only survive process restarts with silent completed history; native reapplication keeps the mode/menu state.

24 exact browser views across three modes, two window sizes, light/dark and 1x/1.5x: default whole-document axe has zero violations/incomplete results. Six exact native DPR2 pairs retain all original asset dimensions.
Frontend/site verify, format, strict default/spike Clippy, 386 serial Rust tests, final release embedding, script lint and complete M11 PNG decode/budget pass.

notAutomated: Installed Windows notification display and notification-center protocol activation; installer execution and app/notification registration are excluded by handoff section0.2. The production notifier is compiled with the configured app identity, but tests construct the real WinRT notification and suppress Show.

Physical Windows taskbar pixels, other OS/hardware/DPI, actual global key presses and fresh idle performance are not claimed. Native icon pixels/API requests and owned window/query/provider seams are verified.
